subject: Your commute just got clearer
preview_text: A 30-second tweak that cuts road noise and brings dialogue forward. Try it now.
body_paragraphs: You know that moment on the train when you crank your phone to max and still can't hear the podcast host over the rumble? I used to sit there, holding my phone inches from my ear, straining. Then I found a setting inside Loud EQ that changed everything.

It's not the volume boost—you already know that works. It's the Podcast profile. Most people tap Optimize and stop. But the Podcast profile does something different: it carves out the frequencies where road noise lives and pushes the human voice forward. Dialogue becomes crisp, not buried. You hear every word without maxing out the volume.

To try it, open Loud EQ, tap the profile icon in the top right, and select Podcast. Then hit Optimize once. That's it. Your commute just got quieter, even when it's loud. This works for audiobooks and calls too.

Open Loud EQ now and swap profiles. Hear the difference. P.S. The Podcast profile is free. If you want to dial it in even further for your specific headphones, Premium's Sound DNA calibration takes 15 seconds and makes it perfect for your ears.
